tools.name: find_available_tables
tools.description: Looks up open tables for a given date, time and party size at a restaurant and returns the matching tables. Does not hold or book anything.

tools.name: cancel_reservation
tools.description: Cancels a reservation by deleting its record and frees the table. Returns the reservation details as they were before it was removed.

params.name: reservation_id
params.description: ID of the reservation to cancel

params.name: guest_phone
params.description: Phone number on the reservation, used to confirm the guest

tools.name: charge_no_show_fee
tools.description: Runs a no-show fee charge against the card on file for a reservation using Stripe. Returns whether the charge succeeded along with the charge ID and amount.

params.name: reservation_id
params.description: ID of the reservation that was missed

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the guest

params.name: party_size
params.description: Number of guests; fee is charged per person

tools.name: refund_reservation_deposit
tools.description: Refunds a reservation's deposit through Stripe, either in full or for a partial amount. Returns a summary of the refund.

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: Stripe PaymentIntent ID of the deposit

params.name: amount_cents
params.description: Amount to refund in cents; omit or use 0 for a full refund

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for the refund, e.g. requested_by_customer
